title: Sources: Singapore-based, Nigeria-focused payments startup OPay halts its $300M US IPO just hours after pricing it due to inquiries from a Chinese regulator (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Singapore-based, Nigeria-focused payments startup OPay halts its $300M US IPO just hours after pricing it due to inquiries from a Chinese regulator — China made eleventh-hour inquiries into OPay Ltd., prompting the Nigeria-focused payments company to halt its $300 million initial public offering …
